title: Thumbnail index
description: A visible five-image dock selects full-frame architectural photographs with a precise white selection edge.
useCase: Browse a short visual sequence while seeing every available image and the current selection.
interaction: Choose a thumbnail. Up, Down, Home and End move the focused selection.

assets.description: Chartres Cathedral, West Facade; Royal Portal, Central Bay
Modern brutalist architecture with geometric shapes
Rue de la Montagne-Sainte-Geneviève near the Intersection of Rue LaPlace (Rue de la Montagne-Sainte-Geneviève prés de carrefour de la rue LaPlace)

reducedMotion: Images switch immediately for reduced motion and keyboard selection; host pause disables the thumbnail buttons.
limitations: The five-image collection intentionally fits without internal scrolling. Longer collections need an explicit scroll or paging strategy. Image rights are separate from the original code.
look: Full-bleed architectural photograph with a large white sans caption bottom-left and a dark rounded vertical rail of five numbered thumbnails, the selected one white-framed.
motion: Choosing a thumbnail crossfades the full image over 260 ms while it settles from 1.025 to 1 scale with a 420 ms ease-out; keyboard selection switches instantly.
adapt: Each `archive` image is stacked as a `.ti-image` whose opacity and `scale` follow `current` through CSS transitions (260 ms fade, 420 ms `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`); `choose` handles selection. Replace `archive` with your images and labels; keep the roving `tabIndex`.
